clue.text: Ruthless boxer to do more than bite opponent's ear?

definitions.meaning: describes cut-throat competition where everyone fights only for themselves

definitions.text: boxer to do more than bite opponent's ear?
definitions.meaning: a boxer is a breed of dog, and its opponent another dog, so it goes beyond biting to devouring

explanation.surface: A brutal prizefighter goes further than chewing a rival's ear in the ring.
explanation.walkthrough: The ear-biting points to a human boxer, but the boxer here is the dog breed, and its rival is another dog.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes a fiercely competitive, merciless situation, so it serves as an adjective for ruthless.

clue.text: Contaminate false teeth with article becoming embedded

indicators.note: the article is set inside the word for false teeth, as if embedded in it

parts.note: a denture is a set of false teeth
A is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Something false teeth pick up spoils them when an item gets stuck.
explanation.definitionFit: To denature a substance is to adulterate or spoil it, for example making alcohol undrinkable.

clue.text: Street urchin gambling not good ultimately

indicators.note: not tells us to leave out the letter for good
ultimately says the letter dropped is the one at the very end of the word

parts.note: gaming is another word for gambling

explanation.surface: A street child takes to betting, which proves no good in the end.
explanation.definitionFit: A gamin is a French-derived word for a scruffy, mischievous child of the streets.

clue.text: Attended to notice, then got ready

parts.note: an ad is a notice or advertisement
dressed means put clothes on, got ready to go out

explanation.surface: Someone read a notice and then prepared to go out.
explanation.definitionFit: To have addressed a problem is to have dealt with or attended to it.

clue.text: Rookie establishes platform in river

indicators.note: in places the platform inside the river's name

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Scotland and in Wales/England
a raft is a floating platform

explanation.surface: A newcomer builds a floating stage on a river.
explanation.definitionFit: A draftee is a conscript, a raw recruit, so a beginner or rookie.

clue.text: One gets little right, being involved in mistake that's beastly

definitions.note: a phrase meaning something that is a beast, an animal

indicators.note: the first pieces are wrapped up inside the word for a mistake

parts.note: a gaffe is a blunder or mistake
I is the Roman numeral for one
R is a short form of right

explanation.surface: A person who gets few rights, caught up in an error, finds it all horrible.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Beastly' looks like a complaint, but the definition asks for something that is a beast.
explanation.definitionFit: The giraffe is a tall African beast, so it is literally a creature that is beastly.

clue.text: Power of aircraft reaching height a little time later

indicators.note: later puts the bit of time after the aircraft and height

parts.note: a MiG is a Russian fighter aircraft
T is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: An aeroplane's power comes from reaching altitude a moment afterwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Might is a synonym of power or strength.

clue.text: Ancient country's means for spreading news

definitions.meaning: The ancient land of the Medes, in what is now Iran; the 's stands for is
the press, television and radio, which carry the news

explanation.surface: An old nation is the vehicle by which reports are spread.
explanation.definitionFit: The press and broadcasting are collectively the channels of mass communication, and Media was also an ancient kingdom.

clue.text: Gardens with the Spanish plant

parts.note: the grounds of a house are its gardens
el is Spanish for the

explanation.surface: Gardens planted with a Spanish flower.
explanation.definitionFit: Groundsel is a common weed of the daisy family, a type of plant.

clue.text: Choirboy to quiver having cut Mass

indicators.note: the letter for Mass is cut out of the word for quiver

parts.note: to tremble is to quiver

explanation.surface: A young chorister shakes after skipping a church service.
explanation.definitionFit: A treble is a boy singer with a high voice, the classic choirboy part.

clue.text: Return' of Pythias's friend, someone who can't settle

indicators.note: return asks for the friend's name to be turned back

parts.note: in Greek legend Damon and Pythias were devoted friends

explanation.surface: The comeback of the loyal friend of Pythias, a restless soul.
explanation.definitionFit: A nomad wanders from place to place, never settling in one home.

clue.text: English bar in a foreign city: place that may be alighted on

definitions.text: place that may be alighted on

indicators.note: in places the English bar inside the a-plus-city group

parts.note: Rome is a city outside Britain
a rod is a bar

explanation.surface: An English pub in an overseas city is a place to land.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bar' suggests a pub and 'in a foreign city' a location, but 'in' is the container signal: English bar goes inside a + city.
explanation.definitionFit: An aerodrome is an airfield, where aircraft come down and alight.

clue.text: Beat man seen to be touching

parts.note: to tan someone is to beat them
a gent is a man

explanation.surface: A man who has been beaten is visibly affected.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Touching' looks like 'moving', but it is the geometry sense: a line that just meets a curve.
explanation.definitionFit: In geometry a tangent line touches a curve at one point without crossing it.

clue.text: Cloth in hedge

definitions.meaning: a soft woollen fabric, or a face cloth
to hedge is to talk evasively, waffle or blather

explanation.surface: A piece of fabric caught in a hedgerow.
explanation.definitionFit: Flannel is woollen cloth, and as a verb it means to talk evasively, to hedge.

clue.text: Type of mail procedure getting letters of prestige sorted specially

indicators.note: specially means the letters are arranged in a special new way

explanation.surface: A postal process in which the letters of a prestigious firm are handled with care.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Letters' looks like post, but it means the letters of PRESTIGE; with SORTED they are rearranged under 'specially'.
explanation.definitionFit: Registered post is a mail service where items are tracked and signed for, a postal procedure.

clue.text: Inexperienced group of women going to church somewhere in London

parts.note: green means naive or inexperienced
the WI is the Women's Institute, a British women's organisation

explanation.surface: A naive women's group heads to church somewhere in the capital.
explanation.definitionFit: Greenwich is a borough of south-east London, home of the meridian.

clue.text: Family origins are not covered by section of book

indicators.note: the inner pieces are held within the word for a section of book

parts.note: a page is part of a book
taken as written
NT is the clipped n't form of not

explanation.surface: A family's roots are not covered in a chapter of the book.
explanation.definitionFit: Parentage means descent or lineage, one's family origins.

clue.text: Kiss puts great big copper behind schedule

parts.note: OS is the abbreviation for outsize
Cu is the chemical symbol for copper
late means behind schedule

explanation.surface: A huge policeman makes the timetable run late.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Copper' suggests a police officer, but it is the metal, chemical symbol Cu.
explanation.definitionFit: To osculate is a formal or humorous word for to kiss.

clue.text: Old documents finally destroyed — by wanton lad — so careless!

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of destroyed
wanton means unruly, so the following letters run wild into a new order

explanation.surface: Ancient papers were ruined by a reckless youth, how negligent!
explanation.walkthrough: 'Finally' takes D from 'destroyed'; 'wanton' rearranges LAD SO CARELESS into EADSEASCROLLS.
explanation.definitionFit: The Dead Sea Scrolls are ancient Jewish manuscripts found near Qumran, famous old documents.

clue.text: Serious listener wanting comfortable retreat

parts.note: the ear is the organ that listens
a nest is a cosy refuge

explanation.surface: A grave listener longs for a snug hideaway.
explanation.definitionFit: Earnest means sincere and serious in intent.

clue.text: Snare taking tail off spaniel

indicators.note: the last letter of the dog breed is removed, its tail cut off

parts.note: a springer is a breed of spaniel

explanation.surface: A trap that docks a dog's tail.
explanation.definitionFit: A springe is a noose or snare for catching small game.

clue.text: Handicap that is restricting politician and journalist

indicators.note: the outer letters hem in the politician and journalist

parts.note: an MP is a Member of Parliament
ED is short for editor

explanation.surface: A drawback that keeps a politician and a reporter in check.
explanation.definitionFit: To impede is to hinder or obstruct, to handicap.

clue.text: Fellow keen, but no leader or boss

parts.note: a man is a fellow

indicators.note: no leader drops the first letter of the word for keen

parts.note: eager means keen

explanation.surface: A man who is eager but not in charge, or else the head.
explanation.definitionFit: A manager is the person in charge at work, a boss.

clue.text: Mathematician is delightful person enthralling us

indicators.note: enthralling means holding captive, so one piece surrounds the other

parts.note: someone who is a gas is great fun
taken as written

explanation.surface: A scholar of numbers is a charming person who captivates us.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Enthralling' reads as captivating but here means holding captive, one piece inside the other; 'a gas' is slang for great fun.
explanation.definitionFit: Carl Friedrich Gauss was a great German mathematician.

clue.text: Our Edna composed a poem

indicators.note: composed means put together, so these letters are arranged afresh

explanation.surface: Our Edna wrote some verse.
explanation.definitionFit: A rondeau is a French verse form of thirteen lines with a refrain, a kind of poem.

clue.text: Source of artistic inspiration evident in opera tonight

indicators.note: evident in says the letters can be seen inside the words opera tonight

explanation.surface: Creative inspiration is apparent in the opera this evening.
explanation.definitionFit: Erato is the Greek Muse of love poetry, and a Muse is a source of inspiration.

clue.text: Despicable type tucking into Eastern food, an advocate of enjoyment

indicators.note: tucking into puts the despicable type inside the Eastern food

parts.note: a pie is food
a cur is a contemptible person
taken as written

explanation.surface: A wretch digs into oriental cuisine, a champion of pleasure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tucking into' suggests eating, but it is the container signal for the despicable type inside the Eastern food.
explanation.definitionFit: An epicurean is devoted to pleasure, especially fine food and drink.

clue.text: A leg at the front of a lizard

indicators.note: at the front of places A and leg before the second a

parts.note: gam is slang for a leg

explanation.surface: A limb at the front of a reptile.
explanation.definitionFit: An agama is an Old World lizard, often brightly coloured.

clue.text: Character getting the things over there back to front

indicators.note: back to front means the back letter is brought to the front

parts.note: those means the things over there

explanation.surface: A personality that gets those items reversed.
explanation.definitionFit: Ethos is the distinctive spirit or character of a person or group.

clue.text: So what could three dots signify?

definitions.meaning: so means for that reason, hence
the logic symbol of three dots in a triangle stands for hence

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about the meaning of an ellipsis.
explanation.walkthrough: Three dots look like an ellipsis, but in a triangle they are the mathematical sign for 'hence'.
explanation.definitionFit: Therefore means consequently, like so, and the triangle of dots is its symbol.
